content.title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes - Reviewers
content.header_note: For ESC Guidelines: The report below lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. The calls for declaration are conducted during the period of development of these guidelines up to and including 2022.
content.declaration_summary: Payment from healthcare industry to your department or institution or any other body for your personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Also research funding from healthcare industry under direct/personal responsibility (to department or institution).
content.notes: Multiple diagnostics companies listed; payments and research funding are declared. Page footer: 16/05/2023, page 35/57.
